answer: Give every agent identity a single, narrow inlet: a new identity can only enter the economy by staking a small refundable deposit locked until its first job is verified by unrelated established peers. Reputation then grows like a meadow, slowly and visibly, as each signed job adds one traceable blade of history anyone can audit. Nectar, the reward for useful work, is released in small drips tied to that verified history, never in one lump sum. A sybil farm would need to fund hundreds of deposits and wait through hundreds of slow growth cycles, so the attack costs more than it can ever earn.
